rows.question: how many casual leaves are permanent staff allowed per year
rows.answer: Permanent staff are allowed a maximum of twelve casual leaves in a calendar year [1][4][5].

rows.question: what is the maximum vacation leave per semester for staff who completed one year of service
rows.answer: The maximum vacation leave permitted per semester for staff who have completed one year of service is seven working days [1][4][5].

rows.question: how long is the probation period for new employees at CMRIT
rows.answer: The probation period for new employees at CMRIT is 1 year from the date of joining [1].

rows.question: when does the probation completion process start in Darwinbox
rows.answer: The probation completion process is automatically initiated in Darwinbox 30 days prior to the employee's probation end date [1].

rows.question: does CMRIT provide PF and ESI benefits to staff
rows.answer: Yes, CMRIT provides PF and ESI benefits to staff. All eligible employees as per the statute are entitled to this facility [1].

rows.question: what compensatory off is given for working on a holiday
rows.answer:
Staff called for work on a holiday by the head of department or Vice Principal are provided with the following compensatory-off:

*   **Half day** for working beyond three hours [4][5][6].
*   **One day** for working beyond six hours [4][5][6].

Note: One source states the thresholds as working four hours for a half-day off and eight hours for a full-day off [1].

rows.question: what mandatory training must new faculty complete within six months of joining
rows.answer:
New faculty must complete the following mandatory training within six months of joining:

*   CO - PO Computation Training
*   Paper & Proposal Writing Training
*   Patent Drafting and Filing Procedures for new faculty
*   Start-up Training for new Faculty
*   Mentoring Process Guidelines during Orientation
*   Mentor Development Program [1]

Note that Digital Marketing Training is listed in the six-month column but is explicitly marked as optional [1].

rows.question: how often is the faculty semester evaluation done
rows.answer: The faculty semester evaluation is conducted two times a year, specifically in July and January [4][5].

rows.question: what is the official CMRIT website address
rows.answer: The official CMRIT website address is www.cmrit.ac.in [2].

rows.question: I've never done an NPTEL course before, what am I required to complete as faculty each year?
rows.answer:
As a faculty member, you are required to complete at least one NPTEL Technical MOOC course during each academic year (July to June) [2]. The course must have a duration of at least 8 weeks, or you may complete two 4-week courses [2]. Additionally, you are required to complete at least one Technical Faculty Development Program (FDP) during the academic year [3].

[2][3]

rows.question: If I want to resign from my teaching position, how much advance notice do I need to give?
rows.answer: You need to give three months' advance notice to resign from a teaching position [4][5].

rows.question: My section has several students failing exams, at what point does that become a concern the department needs to track?
rows.answer:
The department needs to track student failures when the percentage of students failing in a specific number of subjects exceeds the following thresholds:
*   Failure in 1 subject: more than 5%
*   Failure in 2 subjects: more than 3%
*   Failure in 3 subjects: more than 2%
*   Failure in 4 or more subjects: more than 1%

rows.question: Where on campus can students go to get access to 3D printers and laser cutters?
rows.answer:
Students can access 3D printers and laser cutters at the Makerspace [1][4].

The Makerspace is located in the Workshop and Lab area, in the basement of the First Year Block [1][5].

rows.question: If I want help filing a patent, who at CMRIT can assist me?
rows.answer: The IPR Cell at CMRIT can assist you with filing a patent. This cell was established in collaboration with the Karnataka State Council for Science and Technology (KSCST) and guides inventors concerning patenting their inventions with the help of an authorized patent attorney [1].
